movie.title: I, Daniel Blake
movie.overview: A 59-year-old carpenter recovering from a heart attack befriends a single mother and her two kids as they navigate the impersonal, Kafkaesque benefits system. With equal amounts of humour, warmth and despair, the journey is heartfelt and emotional until the end.

facts: Did you know Daniel Blake, the titular character, isn't just a middle-aged man but specifically a 59-year-old carpenter? He's also recovering from a heart attack, which adds a crucial layer to his battle with the benefits system!

The film doesn't feature a typical villain; instead, its true antagonist is described as an 'impersonal, Kafkaesque benefits system.' That really paints a picture of the bureaucratic nightmare Daniel and Katie face!

Despite its heavy subject matter, the movie is noted for its unique tonal balance, featuring 'equal amounts of humour, warmth, and despair.' Sounds like it offers a full spectrum of emotions, not just gloom!
